title: Is the guidance on Proxy and Firewall Support still current?

question.author: member_058
question.body: I found an older discussion about proxy and firewall support. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Desktop Client documentation says: All traffic goes to CloudBox over port 443; firewalls that allow standard HTTPS need no extra rules. Corporate environments with TLS inspection may cause "Syncing…" to stall — add an exception for the CloudBox endpoints or contact support for the enterprise network guide. The desktop client honors HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies configured in Settings > Network, and it respects the system proxy by default. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
